content: Vectorworks Spotlight integrates directly with GDTF-Share for fixture search/download, auto-links manufacturer GDTF files to devices, offers an 'Update GDTF Files' command that refreshes linked fixtures from GDTF-Share with user control over which fixtures update and whether to keep or replace DMX modes, and exports full MVR packages (with linked GDTFs) for handoff to previz/console/colleagues.
